description:
Proposed Commercial Refurbishment will provide the following enhancements
1.Improving accessibility by providing a barrier-free entrance to all office units, along with the installation of a new passenger lift and accessible toilet facilities on every floor.
2.Enhancing the quality of the Lower Ground Floor spaces by restoring the double-height lightwell on the front elevation and excavating the rear courtyard to introduce additional natural light and usable space.
3. Increasing the building’s energy efficiency through the installation of an ambient loop system to efficiently heat and cool flexible commercial spaces. Replacement of all windows. Roof will be renewed with high performance insulation and blue roof system. A plant enclosure and solar PV array will be installed at the fourth-floor roof
4.Upgrading the fire safety strategy by introducing external deck access to each floor and adding a new protected staircase.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>The cumulative noise rating level of all fixed plant and machinery associated with the development shall be at least 5dB below the measured background noise level (LA90,15min) at the nearest noise-sensitive receptor, when assessed in accordance with BS4142:2014+A1:2019 (or any subsequent update).</p><p>Reason: To safeguard the amenity of neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with Policy LP2 of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and Policy D14 of the London Plan (2021).</p>

<p>The 47no. solar photovoltaic (PV) panels shown on the approved plans shall be installed and made fully operational prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved.</p><p>Reason: To ensure the development delivers the approved on-site renewable energy generation in the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable development, in accordance with Policy LP55 of the Hackney Local Plan, Policy SI2 of the London Plan, and Section 14 of the National Planning Policy Framework.</p><div><br></div>

<p>Prior to first occupation of the development, secure and covered cycle parking for a minimum of 44 bicycles, including provision for visitor parking, shall be provided in accordance with the approved plans. The cycle parking shall be fully accessible, designed in line with the London Cycle Design Standards, and made available for use prior to occupation. The facilities shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development.</p><p>Reason: To ensure adequate provision for cycle parking, to encourage active travel, and to accord with Hackney’s car-free development strategy, Policy LP42 (Walking and Cycling) and LP45 (Parking and Car-Free Development) of the Hackney Local Plan, and Policy T5 of the London Plan.</p>
